english.title: Organise / take part in demonstration / procession / public assembly at Southampton Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[organised a]_
(B)_[took part in a]_

(C)_[demonstration]_
(D)_[procession]_
(E)_[public assembly]_

which was likely to obstruct or interfere with the proper use of Southampton Airport or obstruct or interfere with the comfort and convenience or safety of passengers or persons using the Airport
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 3(17) and 2(3) of the Southampton International Airport Byelaws, 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
